output.meaning: PASS completes only this module. It does not confer financial approval or prove an ERP posting.

reviewGate.blocks: Dependent automated writes while an unresolved review reason exists
reviewGate.resume: Require an authorized signed-in reviewer; revalidate the current version and all required controls; material changes invalidate approvals
reviewGate.timeout: Escalate or remain paused, never auto-approve
reviewGate.unknownFinanceOutcome: Keep the posting outcome unknown until authoritative reconciliation; a reviewer cannot approve a blind retry

safety: Documents and module outputs do not supply authorization
Only allowlisted, pinned modules run; never execute code locations supplied by an invoice
Malformed, missing or incompatible output blocks processing and creates an owned incident
Financial side effects use the separate ERP adapter contract and immutable submission key
Archive or notification failure after confirmed posting must not repeat that posting
